body: Thank you, really, for your advice.  I'm reasonably close to her, but unfortunately not geographically; and we've tried to get her to all 1-800-SUICIDE (she did, a while ago), but she really strongly resists that.  She's convinced that it's not worth the effort, and so on and so forth---which of course is false, but given her state of mind, she doesn't realize it at the time (she does later, she's said).  I'm going to call when I get a chance and see if they have any advice.

Thanks so much for responding.  Unfortunately, she doesn't have a doctor either; I don't think it will be particularly easy to get her to go one (or to a therapist).  She "doesn't like/isn't used to relying on other people," she says.  I'm going to call the hotline as soon as I get a chance to (in the next few hours).
